headline: Dutch Gas Network Operator Gasunie Proposes Strategic Reserve
summary: Dutch gas network operator Gasunie urged the Netherlands to create a strategic gas reserve to boost energy security amid international supply disruptions and rising heating demand.
why: Gasunie manages the gas infrastructure in the Netherlands, a key hub for European energy distribution.

impacts.name: European natural gas utilities
impacts.why: Proposals for strategic reserves impact inventory management and storage costs for network operators.
